# Test fixtures

Generated by `explore/make_fixtures.py` (seed 42) from the real PX4 index and three real ULogs. Don't edit them by hand: re-run the script, which keeps this README. `expected.json` holds the counts that the Phase 4 tests assert against.

| File | What it is | What the ingest code must do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dbinfo_sample.json` | 200 real index records, stratified so every known defect appears (see `expected.json` → `defect_counts`) | Load all 200 into bronze |
| `dbinfo_sample_next_day.json` | The same snapshot a "day" later: +5 new logs, 1 record whose `rating` went `""` → `"good"` | Diff: 5 `insert`, 1 `update`, 199 unchanged (nothing appended for those) |
| `dbinfo_corrupt.json` | 1 valid control record followed by 8 bad ones, each tagged with `_expect_reason` | Load the control record; send the other 8 to `bronze.rejected_records` with the reasons listed |
| `dbinfo_truncated.json.gz` | A gzip cut in half | Fail the whole snapshot (gzip `EOFError`) before touching bronze |
| `ulog/<log_id>.ulg` | 3 small real ULogs: Quadrotor (no `battery_status`), Fixed Wing (battery stuck at 0, no GPS topic), Tiltrotor VTOL (GPS UTC available). Their index rows are in `dbinfo_sample.json`. | Parse to 1 Hz telemetry; tolerate missing topics |
| `ulog/truncated.ulg` | The first 100 KB of the Quadrotor log | Reject as `size_mismatch`: **pyulog parses it without error**, so only the size check catches it |
| `ulog/not_a_ulog.ulg` | An HTML 503 page saved as `.ulg` | Reject as `invalid_ulog_header` |

Data: public logs from PX4 Flight Review (review.px4.io).
